blocks.text: Qadam ba qadam guide: Excel ya Google Sheets mein visualization banane ka saada tareeqa:

items: Data likhein (Enter Your Data): spreadsheet mein data likhein. Misal: ek column mein mahine (January, February waghaira) aur doosre mein har mahine ki sales.
Data select karein (Select the Data): jis data ka chart banana hai us par mouse se click kar ke ghaseet kar highlight karein.
Chart ki qism chunein (Choose a Chart Type): "Insert" tab par click kar ke chart ki qism chunein (bar chart, line graph waghaira).
Chart sanwarein (Customize the Chart): chart wazeh karne ke liye labels lagayein, maslan x-axis par mahine aur y-axis par sales. Is se chart samajhna aasan hota hai.
Statistical representation samjhein: chart banane ke baad samajhna zaroori hai ke chart kya bata raha hai.

blocks.text: Misal: Bar charts: categories ka muwazna, jaise mahana sales.
Line graphs: waqt ke saath rujhan, jaise kai mahinon mein sales kaise barhi ya ghati.

blocks.prompt: Data visualizations ki qismein aur un ke istemal par bahas kijiye. (Long question 3)
blocks.explanation: Bar charts categories ka muwazna karte hain (product ke hisab se sales). Line graphs waqt ke saath tabdeeli dikhate hain (din bhar ka temperature ya roz ki kamai). Histograms ek variable ki bins mein taqseem dikhate hain (exam scores). Scatterplots do variables ka taluq dikhate hain (ghante aur marks) aur rujhan aur outliers pehchanne mein madad dete hain. Boxplots median, quartiles aur outliers se phailao ka khulasa aur groups (classes) ka muwazna karte hain. Pie charts kul ke hisse dikhate hain aur heatmaps grid mein qeematon ke liye rang istemal karte hain (yeh do kitab mein sirf naam se aaye hain).

items: Spreadsheet chart: data likhna, select karna, Insert se chart, labels, phir samajhna.
